generated_doNotEdit.title: Trail
generated_doNotEdit.description: Causes an entity to leave a trail of blocks as it moves about the world.

fields.title: Block Type
fields.description: The type of block you wish to be spawned by the entity as it move about the world. Solid blocks may not be spawned at an offset of (0,0,0).

fields.title: Spawn Filter
fields.description: One or more conditions that must be met in order to cause the chosen block type to spawn.

fields.title: Spawn Offset
fields.description: The distance from the entities current position to spawn the block. Capped at up to 16 blocks away. The X value is left/right(-/+), the Z value is backward/forward(-/+), the Y value is below/above(-/+).

generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Entity Trail
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Causes an entity to leave a trail of blocks as it moves about the world. Obeys Mob Griefing rules.

fields.title: Block Type
fields.description: The type of block that is spawned as a trail behind the entity. Solid blocks cannot be spawned at an offset of (0, 0, 0).

fields.title: Force Replace Matched Blocks
fields.description: When true, the trail will replace blocks that match the replaceable blocks list even if normal placement rules prevent it.

fields.title: Radius
fields.description: When provided, the trail spawns blocks across a (2 * radius + 1) by (2 * radius + 1) horizontal area centered on the spawn offset. Uses the legacy four-corner sampling when omitted.
A list of blocks that can be replaced by the trail block. If the block at the spawn offset is not in this list, the trail block will not spawn. If omitted it will default to only air blocks.
One or more conditions that must be met in order to cause the chosen block type to spawn.

fields.title: Domain
fields.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

fields.title: Subject
fields.description: The subject of this filter test.

fields.title: Test
fields.description: The name of the test to apply.

fields.title: Value
fields.description: The value being compared with the test.

fields.title: Spawn Offset
fields.description: The offset from the entity's current position at which to spawn the block, capped at 16 blocks away.
